description: PROJECT_FACTS claims the engine injects GITHUB_TOKEN into every agent shell (resolve_workflow_env) and runs a git credential bridge, but the develop implementer stage shell carries NO GITHUB_TOKEN, no credential helper, no SSH keys (verified run fabro-70af PART 2b, 2026-10-01: git push https://github.com/denkhaus/petri.git fails 'could not read Username'). The user-unlocked petri fork push therefore cannot land in-run; seed fabro-70af's own fallback (DIRECT session lands the fork advance, re-dispatch the fabro-side wiring) had to be taken. Fix idea: have resolve_workflow_env actually export the token to command-handler agent shells, or expose an engine git-push surface for authorized fork repos.
resolution: unresolved in-run: fork commit 0456785 waits in the local checkout for a DIRECT-session push; engine fix (token export to agent shells) still open
